Choosing a key

Few values, used in filters

Good keys
date, month
what your queries filter on
Bad keys
address, hash
millions of values: millions of tiny files
ALTER TABLE … SET PARTITIONED BY (year(block_timestamp), month(block_timestamp)): applies to new data only.
